known.summary: The condition of `spawnOmp` is inverted. It keeps the environment of this process, with `XDG_DATA_HOME`, when the locked data root is the config root, and it removes `XDG_DATA_HOME` when the locked data root is the XDG root. So in both layouts the omp child resolves a data root that the sync did not lock and can write into it, which the doc comment and the pull request exist to prevent. The pull request adds ompChild.ts: the base has no such file and no pinned omp child.
